gen-dafont-conthrax-gf-noto-sans-modi: Conthrax draws wide, geometric letters whose round shapes carry the same heft as the straight ones, with a look that feels machined. Noto Sans Modi stays open inside every curve.
gen-dafont-conthrax-gf-noto-sans-mono: Sleek and clean up top, Conthrax looks drawn with a compass, while Noto Sans Mono below spaces its sturdy, tall lowercase generously. The two feel like a machine panel beside a tidy typewriter.
gen-dafont-conthrax-gf-noto-sans-mro: Noto Sans Mro reads dense and tall through the middle of each word, with generous entrances into every letter. And Conthrax, steady in pressure from first letter to last, is the one built to announce.
gen-dafont-conthrax-gf-noto-sans-multani: Modern and quick, Noto Sans Multani leads with a lofty x-height. Conthrax is best at carving out a heading with one uniform cut, while the body font is best at opening its e wide for easy reading.
gen-dafont-conthrax-gf-noto-sans-myanmar: Noto Sans Myanmar reads as a thick, heavy strip of text, its c opening broad and welcoming. But Conthrax, a monoline heading, does its best work when the lettering needs to look crisp and futuristic.
gen-dafont-conthrax-gf-noto-sans-nabatae: Contemporary in feel, Noto Sans Nabataean lets its lowercase stand almost cap-tall, with wide-open s curves. And Conthrax follows with strokes that never pinch at the curves, so the heading and text move as one.
gen-dafont-conthrax-gf-noto-sans-nag-mun: Conthrax holds its stroke width constant through every curve and corner, a rigid, geometric look. And Noto Sans Nag Mundari brings lowercase that rivals the capitals, which is where the pair is most striking.
gen-dafont-conthrax-gf-noto-sans-nandina: Conthrax has a pipe-cleaner look to its strokes, wide and geometric in the lowercase a. Noto Sans Nandinagari does the quieter job, keeping openings generous with a big, approachable body.
gen-dafont-conthrax-gf-noto-sans-newa: Wide, wiry and futuristic: Conthrax traces each letter with a line of constant weight. Noto Sans Newa then carries a longer passage with an open-mouthed e and tall counters, so the text feels easy to follow.
gen-dafont-conthrax-gf-noto-sans-nushu: Noto Sans Nushu reads towering and spacious, with terminals held far from the stroke body, which makes each word feel lifted. Conthrax, traced as if with a marker, supplies the bold geometric contrast.
